jobs.title: Lead, Creative Operations
jobs.description:
Amca is building America’s new industrial base. Since the 1990s, our ability to build new aviation and military systems and maintain the ones we already have has eroded. Today, the gap between what the nation needs to produce and what it is capable of producing is the largest it has been in generations.

To help close that gap, Amca rapidly develops and manufactures new critical components and subsystems required to build and sustain the planes, military vehicles, and core infrastructure America needs. Today, we operate seven factories nationwide, including our advanced prototyping and testing headquarters in El Segundo, and deliver avionics, hydraulic, and electrical components for platforms such as the F-35, F-16, F/A-18, 737MAX, 787, A320neo, A321, Mk-48, and M1 Abrams.

Overview

Amca’s Lead for Creative Operations will be responsible for managing and implementing our brand vision and marketing goals across all mediums, especially those that are operationally intensive (film/media production, events, factory renovations). This person will sit on the Growth team, work closely with the company’s Senior Manager of Creative and Marketing, and report to the VP of Growth.

The right candidate is excellent at project management, isn’t afraid to be aggressive with slow vendors, and also has uncompromising taste which will be used to make the dozens of small creative decisions required during execution to realize a broader vision. They probably have between 2-5 years of experience working in real estate development, film production, or complex startup project management.

Responsibilities

While the set of projects that falls under Creative Operations is ever-changing, below are examples of the kinds of work this person will own across both project management and creative production:   



Renovate each of our factories as rapidly as possible.Work with the right set of architects and general contractors across the country to bring our aesthetic vision for physical space (pioneered in our office, as featured in Dezeen) to life across all of our facilities around the country.Be the primary point person for the architect, GC, and factory general manager for each renovation.Balance speed/economy and aesthetic vision, making decisions with the architect and GC that allow us to implement our office motifs as efficiently as possible (e.g., getting in the details of finish specs, making the right trade-offs with the architectural designers in service of efficiency while maintaining overall feel.Own the build-out of future space around our HQ in Los Angeles.Do the same set of work as above for future expansion space around our HQ in LA, as we expand beyond the existing space we have.Own execution of major events that we put on as a company, including but not limited to major industry summits, all-company events, large recruiting events, and more.Work with other members of the Amca team and vendors to organize and execute on grand event visions with extreme time constraints.Supports execution of complementary projects: film and other media productions; trade show booth build-outs; factory showroom and customer experience design; Amca-branded merch production and delivery.
Annual Salary Range

$115,000 - $155,000 USD

jobs.title: Creative Operations & Production Trainee, Game Show Group
jobs.description:
About the position

Our Emerging Talent Programs, which include Interns and Trainees, offer unique opportunities for students, recent graduates, and emerging talent to work alongside the teams that come together to create movies, TV shows, and other great experiences. These seasonal, paid assignments provide meaningful and productive work that allows you to build on your experience and develop your skills further. You will be provided with challenging tasks, real-world experience, and many educational and social networking opportunities. This Summer/Fall 2026 Trainee position is from June 2026 to December 4, 2026 (start and end dates are flexible based on your schedule), and all candidates must be able to work 40 hours a week, Monday through Friday in the specified location. This type of opportunity will jump-start your career and prepare you for a career in the desired field. This is not a remote role. A hybrid work option may or may not be available. We work for the Brand Creative & Digital Marketing Team, as part of Sony Pictures Television. Our team is part of the Game Show Group, and we work across several different lanes/workflows - Wheel of Fortune, Jeopardy!, Raid the Cage, and any other property currently in development. We support internal stakeholders (producers, content managers, creatives, executives) and external partners, as well as the consumer products, mobile games, licensing, and development teams. Our team works on campaigns and projects for our various workflows and deliverables, including events, newsletters, sizzle & sales reels, print ads, on-air promos, digital and social campaigns, show graphics packages, logos, pitch decks, and other custom graphics. Our remit covers the full production lifecycle for content creation, video and graphics in the marketing/branding space, from pre-production and planning through kickoff, execution and post-mortem.

Responsibilities

Work closely with the Manager and Senior Manager to support creative operations/production duties in Airtable and our DAM, such as resource/traffic management, scoping & forecasting, out-of-office tracking, reviewing creative briefs, intake and activation of new creative requests and asset managementDistill real-time information and take live notes during meetings – reviews, briefings, kickoff – and help identify/execute any action items. This also includes preparing weekly meeting agenda for live syncs with creative and production team members, and/or helping to prepare a written weekly team-wide status reportBuild, test, launch, and troubleshoot grid, Gantt, Kanban, and calendar views along with other interfaces and reporting dashboards for different teams within our division. Help with active Airtable maintenance and evolution - solidifying information hierarchies, building and testing formulas and automations, customizing interfaces and dashboards, researching new product releases and proposing use cases to support team growthSupport Senior Manager with staffing and onboarding/offboarding, which includes scheduling interviews, updating candidate tracker, prepping internal stakeholders for interview panels, sending templated emails to new hires, adding/removing system access, and working with internal teams on equipment needsCentralize all production calendars (tape days, air dates, etc.) within Airtable while also helping to audit, log, organize and add new documentation to our branded assets tracker and library of brand HQsRequirements

Minimum 1-2 years’ experience in creative operations, with at least 1 year producing creative content for a brand and/or agencyBaseline understanding of the creative workflows for graphic design, video, and animationMac, Google Suite experience a mustFamiliarity with Airtable bases and interfaces is required; at minimum, need to be familiar with production & project management SaaSCan rapidly disseminate and organize data, optimize information architecture, and craft standardized naming conventionsNice-to-haves

Background in television or entertainment is a plusExcellent verbal and written communication skillsSelf-motivated, quick on their feet with ability to pivot; creative problem solverManages time appropriately and meets aggressive deadlinesBenefits

This role may also qualify for comprehensive benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Creative Operations
jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.
 


Roku is changing how the world watches TV
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.


From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.


 


The Role
We are looking for a Senior Manager, Creative Operations to lead the end-to-end operational engine of the Project Management team for Roku’s Brand & Creative Studio. This role sits at the intersection of brand, creative, marketing, product, and operations — responsible for creating clarity, driving scalable processes, and enabling the team to deliver bold, best-in-class creative work at speed and scale.


The ideal candidate is an experienced people leader and strategic operator who has built and evolved project management and operations practices within high-performing in-house or agency creative organizations, ideally in streaming or entertainment. They are a proactive partner with a head for systems and process design, a pragmatic, strategic approach to problem solving, and a self-starter attitude. They are non-political, with the ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across different business and functional teams.


Our industry changes quickly, so we expect this leader to be comfortable responding to changing business needs, using data and insight to make decisions in ambiguity, and knowing that their success comes when the team succeeds.


For California Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $167,000 - $198,200 annually.


Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.


This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.         


 


What You’ll Do

Lead the day-to-day and long-term evolution of the Project Management and Operations team inside the Creative Studio, ensuring product teams have the right tools, processes and resources to execute on-time, on-budget, on-brief creative deliverables.
Serve as a primary point of contact between Creative Studio and cross-functional partners for planning, prioritization, and status of work across multiple time zones and geographies.
Own resource and prioritization management, measurement and reporting working to reconcile quarterly reporting against capacity.  
As part of resource management both internally and externally, own and facilitate the relationship with vendors of the Creative Studio, helping teams secure resourcing, and overseeing contracts and relationships.
Establish and refine operational frameworks, SLAs, reporting and standards for how Creative Studio partners with Marketing, Product and Advertising — making it simple and predictable to work with the team by refining global workflows and tooling.
Manage and grow a high-performing project management team, providing clear direction, coaching, and career growth opportunities to build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement, where the team feels empowered to lead projects raise issues early and propose solutions.
Identify and champion AI and automation opportunities (e.g., for intake triage, resourcing, status reporting, asset management, or documentation) to streamline workflows, unlock efficiency, and improve quality of work.
Model Roku’s culture and values — acting as a culture carrier within the Brand & Creative team and across the broader organization evangelizing our work, our standards, and to build trust and partnership.

 


Your Experience

8-10+ years of experience in creative operations, marketing operations, or project management, with significant experience in integrated marketing or creative development; streaming, entertainment, or subscription business strongly preferred.
5+ years of people management experience leading project management / operations teams in an in-house creative org or agency.
Demonstrated success building and evolving processes and frameworks for creative or marketing organizations — not just operating within existing ones.
Proven track record driving cross-functional alignment across marketing, product, content, advertising, and other partners, including working across multiple time zones and geographies.
Experience implementing and optimizing project management tools and systems such as Asana, Workfront, Airtable, Jira, or similar, plus strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and presentation tools.
Skilled communicator with strong verbal, presentation, and written communication skills — able to succinctly communicate with executives, stakeholders, and creatives.
Comfortable making data-informed decisions in ambiguous, fast-changing environments; able to balance speed, quality, and risk.
Demonstrated experience mentoring and growing talent, creating clarity on roles and expectations, and supporting career development.
Experience evaluating and/or implementing AI and automation tools within creative or marketing workflows is a plus.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business, or related discipline preferred, but not required.

 


#LI-CU1
 


Our Hybrid Work Approach
Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy.


 


Benefits
Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.


 


Accommodations
Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.


 


The Roku Culture
Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 


We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 


To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.


By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

jobs.title: Creative Operations Manager
jobs.description:
XPRIZE OVERVIEW

XPRIZE is an established global leader in designing and executing large-scale competitions to solve humanity's greatest challenges. As a 501(c)3, our unique model democratizes innovation by incentivizing crowd-sourced, scientifically viable solutions to create a more equitable and abundant future for all. Since our founding in 1994, we've awarded over $500M in prize purses, inspired thousands of global innovators, and collaborated with the most forward-thinking changemakers of our time. We operate across 5 areas of impact, including:

Energy, Climate & NatureFood, Water & WasteDeep Tech & ExplorationLearning & SocietyHealthJoin XPRIZE to help empower humanity to achieve breakthroughs and architect a more equitable and abundant future for all.

Position Description

The Creative Operations Manager is the central point of coordination for XPRIZE Marketing's production pipeline. This role functions as air traffic control: capturing incoming work, routing it to the right owners, tracking it through delivery, and keeping platforms clean, current, and reliable.

The ideal candidate brings real experience from a high-output agency environment, trafficking deliverables and scheduling resources across multiple workstreams simultaneously. Theyre technically comfortable with platforms like Airtable and digital asset management tools, but what sets them apart is their ability to operate at tempo. Theyve worked in fast-moving, multi-stakeholder production environments and they thrive in that pace. This isnt an on-the-job training role. This is someone who already knows how to keep a pipeline moving, communicate across departments, and give leadership clear visibility into whats on track and whats at risk.

A core pillar of this role is project management discipline across complex, multi-stakeholder work. Tracking milestones, dependencies, and long-range initiatives with enough flexibility to adapt as priorities evolve, while keeping work visible and moving through the system.

Responsibilities:

Intake, Routing, and Pipeline Coordination

Own the input of all deliverables into the tracking system, working within approved campaigns to assign deadlines, coordinate resourcing, and engage external vendors as needed.Capture incoming marketing and production requests, ensuring they are logged with complete information and routed to the appropriate owners across all Marketing disciplines.Capture and track campaign and ad hoc asset requests across both long-term initiatives and short-term needs, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.Track status across active workstreams, flag risks early, and ensure follow-through from intake to delivery and archive.Monitor schedules, deliverables, and timelines across active workstreams, keeping production on track and flagging slippage early.Support weekly status/production meetings and reporting, providing concise visibility into whats in motion, whats blocked, and whats at risk.Maintain milestone visibility across active initiatives. Track dependencies, flag timeline impacts when priorities shift, and surface schedule risks before they become problems.Communicate regularly with key stakeholders to keep them informed on progress, upcoming milestones, and potential risks.Platform Administration and Workflow Operations

Manage and maintain the operational systems that track work and store assets, ensuring teams can rely on accurate and current information.Ensure data integrity across fields, statuses, naming conventions, and handoff requirements so reporting and tracking stay reliable.Support onboarding for new users, including staff, freelancers, and vendors, into systems, standards, and best practices.Media Asset Support and File Governance

Maintain folder structures, naming conventions, version control practices, and storage standards for creative work and final deliverables.Guide stakeholders toward correct approved versions through consistent standards and platform usage, reducing duplication and rework.Support ongoing improvements to digital asset management practices in coordination with Creative Operations, Marketing, and IT as needed.Qualifications:

7 to 9 years in a role that blends project coordination, trafficking workflow operations, and cross-team communication. Examples include creative operations manager, traffic coordinator, content operations, or production coordinator.Project management experience supporting complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives. Comfortable tracking milestones, dependencies, and timelines across long-range work while adapting to change.Hands-on familiarity with project management and workflow platforms like Airtable. Experience building forms, views, dashboards, and maintaining data integrity to keep work trackable and reporting reliable.Familiarity with digital asset management platforms and the principles behind them: taxonomy, metadata, naming conventions, versioning, and findability.Exposure to or comfort working alongside creative production, video production, and post-production workflows. Enough fluency to keep files, statuses, and stakeholders aligned, even if not hands-on in the tools.Extremely organized, detail-oriented, and consistent. Able to keep systems clean while operating at speed.Clear, proactive communicator who can work across creatives, producers, marketers, vendors, and technical stakeholders.Comfortable navigating ambiguity. Able to take a loose problem and turn it into a trackable system with accountable owners.Competencies required for this role:

Project Management Fundamentals: milestones, dependencies, long-range tracking, flexibility under changePlatform Fluency: Airtable preferred, plus comfort with DAM and MAM platformsWorkflow Operations: forms, views, dashboards, data integrityIntake Management: request logging, routing, follow-throughCross-Team Communication and Stakeholder ServiceFile Organization, Naming Standards, and Version ControlPipeline Visibility, Reporting, and Risk FlaggingProcess Documentation and Light TrainingVendor and Freelancer Onboarding into Tools and StandardsThe anticipated base salary for this position is $100,000 to $115,000 and may also qualify for an annual incentive. This role is eligible for our extensive benefits package and generous paid time off including vacation, sick, and holidays. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors including the qualifications of the individual applicant, years of relevant experience for the role, level of education attained, and certifications and/or other licenses held. XPRIZE is a remote-first environment.

The XPRIZE FOUNDATION is an equal opportunity employer and does not unlawfully discriminate in employment. Equal access to employment, services, and programs is available to all persons. Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a representative of the organization.

Please note: Though submitting a resume to the XPRIZE FOUNDATION implies that you are interested in a position(s), it does not imply that you are an applicant. You are not considered an applicant until you have been contacted directly by a Talent Acquisitions representative requesting that you begin the designated application process, which may involve phone and/or in-person interview(s), job-related testing, and background checks.
